scope.title: Provider credential-use boundary ledger (image override)
scope.source: policy unit verification + call-site pin (no live provider/credential)

decision.reason: Existing credential-use tests (15) pass; new ledger guard verifies the policy matrix and pins the single call site. Explicit provider override under external/unknown provenance is confined to the host-bound provider scope; no credential value is a policy input. Other credential users recorded as residual.

residual.singleCallSite: The gate is consulted only by image-generate-tool.ts's explicit model-override path; other credential users (chat/model override, other provider-credential consumers) are NOT covered by this policy.
residual.hardcodedFlag: The call site passes hasExplicitModelOverride: true (the branch is itself the override path), so the policy's no-override allow branch is only exercised by unit tests, not by that production call site.
residual.scope: Image-generation provider override only; does not cover key storage, rotation, or leakage surfaces.

independentVerification.detail: The guard resolves the policy across provenance x override x provider-scope, asserts no credential-value field in the input type, and pins the single call site. No separate second-agent verifier role was run.

acceptanceCriteria.note: trusted/operator override and the no-override default/fallback path are unchanged.
external/derived-untrusted/missing/invalid provenance with an explicit override may only use a host-bound image provider; otherwise denied.
The policy input type carries provenance + provider scope only; no credential value is an input, and denial happens before any credential read.
Single call site and the hardcoded override flag are recorded as residual; other credential users are out of scope.
No second credential strategy; default provider, fallback and credential storage unchanged.
15 existing + 4 new tests pass, typecheck:test 0, scoped lint 0, harness validate/dry-run pass, comms 0, credential scan 0 hits, SHA256SUMS verifiable.

notMeasured: A separate second-agent independent verifier role.

landing.note: Pushed with the evidence commit in the same session; see the branch's PR.
